meta.welcome_id: Kami memulai Ramayani lebih dari 20 tahun lalu karena saya suka memasak makanan Indonesia terbaik untuk keluarga dan teman-teman kami. Banyak hidangan tradisional kami seperti Gado Gado, Sate, dan Rendang Sapi berasal dari resep keluarga turun-temurun. Selamat makan!
meta.welcome_en: We started Ramayani over 20 years ago because I loved cooking the best Indonesian food for our friends and family. Many of our traditional dishes such as Gado Gado, Satay, and Beef Rendang are derived from generations of family recipes. We are always creating new flavors — look out for our specials! Selamat Makan!

recipes.review_notes: Fully rewritten from the original scan (Ayam Goreng Kuning.png) on 2026-08-22 — a restaurant-batch recipe for 20 whole chickens. The original page has two dash-separated quantities on almost every blended-paste ingredient (e.g. '16 cup — 4 cup' for water); per Arman's decision, only the first (larger) number was kept — the second number's meaning (reduced batch? alternate measure?) is unconfirmed and was not recorded. The previous data was also missing the entire 'additional ingredients' section (12 items, written in pencil at the bottom of the page) — now added. Two ingredient names could not be identified: 'maherom' (blended list, 3 cups) and 'Jaren' (additional list, 1 cup + 5 tsp) — both need confirming with Ibu, and are marked as unidentified rather than guessed at. The '+20' beside canned chili is also unclear — could be a piece count or a separate note. The only method actually written on the page is 'combine and stir' for the blended paste — no braise/fry steps or timings are given; the customary technique for this dish (marinate/braise then fry) is not transcribed here since it wasn't written on the source page. The previous data's other 'step' ('Diblender: air, sereh, muncang...') was just a restatement of four ingredient names, not a real instruction, so it was dropped. Ingredients are now grouped into two sections (Diblender / Bahan tambahan) matching the page layout, using the new `section` field on Ingredient.
